entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I... I have a VeloBand GPS Tracker and I think I need to return it. I'm just so confused by the whole thing.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, can you help me understand what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the band, or more of a personal preference?
Oh, it's not broken or anything. It's just... a lot. All the settings and the app, it's more than I thought. I just don't think I'll use it. I'm not sure what to do.
I understand. It can definitely take some getting used to. Let me just pull up your account here. I see you received the band 19 days ago. Is that correct?
Yes, I think that's right. It was a gift for myself after the holidays.

Okay. Well, I'll be honest, we recently updated our procedures. For a worn item like this, after so much time has passed, it's often considered too late for a return. We have a strict health and sanitation policy to consider, for hygiene reasons.
Oh no. Really? I didn't see that on the website. The policy pages are so confusing. I thought I had more time. Can't you just help me? I feel a bit overwhelmed by this.
Of course. Let me not get ahead of myself. Let me double-check the exact policy attached to your specific model. One moment, please... Ah, okay, I see what's going on. My apologies for the confusion.

No, actually it's good news. It looks like your VeloBand GPS Tracker was purchased just before our new policy took effect. Your device is still covered under our previous 90-day return window. So, you are well within the timeframe to make a return for a full refund.
Oh, thank goodness! That's such a relief. Thank you for checking that for me.

You're very welcome. I'm happy to help. I've just emailed you a pre-paid return shipping label and instructions. Just pack the device in its original box and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed within 3 to 5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist with?
No, that's perfect. You've been a great help, Isaac. Thank you so much!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
